blocks.html: Valentine’s Day is worth spending with the people you truly care for. You need not spend on expensive gifts, pay for luxurious dinners and even travel far for an unforgettable date with your beau because Robinsons Malls got you covered with its various #relationshipgoals activities and offerings. Robinsons Magnolia’s Sweets for My Sweet Chocolates are ubiquitous on Valentine’s Day but it’s better if you get hold of one of the best tasting – Villa del Conte Sachetto. This mouthwatering Italian praline confection is free, just present a single receipt purchase of P2,500 from Robinsons Magnolia restaurants from February 11-19. Love Lock , Love Walls, Photo Walls Show how much you love your sweetheart and lock it at Robinsons Place Gen. Trias and Robinsons Sta. Rosa’s Love Luck on February 14. And if that’s not enough, there will be a Love Wall where you can write and scribble on your messages and well wishes for your loved ones. Southerners will also have the option to go to Robinsons Place Lipa and write their testament of love on its Love Wall from February 12 -14. Do not forget to snap your favorite moments and make use of the instagram-worthy backdrops and photo op displays located in the following Robinsons Malls- Robinsons Place Imus and Robinsons Place Dasma from February 11-16; Summit Ridge Promenade until February 28; Robinsons Place Manila from February 11- 19; and Robinsons Starmills until February 15. Get Artistic Level up and get creative! Channel the artist in you and get inked with your darling. In Robinsons Place Lipa, couples can avail of free henna tattoo and even design their couple mug by just presenting a P2,000 single receipt purchase from any retail outlets of the mall. Valentine Bazaar Shop for various unique and quality gift items at affordable prices for your special someone at Robinsons Galleria Valentine’s Bazaar from February 13-17. Surprise your love lovey-dovey with a personalized gift from a wide selection from its shops. I Do Robinsons Place Malolos, in partnership with its local government unit and PAG-BIG Fund will sponsor a mass wedding for its members. This event will allow 100 couples to get married in civil ceremonies. Witness this heartfelt event on February 14. On the other hand, Robinsons Place Pangasinan has a special treat to the soon-to-weds. In cooperation with EventsVenuePH, Robinsons Place Pangasinan will hold a 2-day Wedding and Debut caravan on February 25-26 that will showcase a gathering of the best homegrown suppliers of the province. Must Love Cars No love life, no problem! Robinsons Place Pangasinan in partnership with Rockstar Productions invites car enthusiasts on February 11-12 at Parking 2 for its Carshow Madness 2 event. Witness the gathering of car enthusiasts as they flaunt their modified, stylistic, and fiercest car collections. To know more about other Robinsons Malls events and Valentine’s Day promos, follow Robinsons Malls in Facebook: www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter:@RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial.
